data.title: Rainy Day Routines
data.description: Discover when different fun activities happen on a rainy day!

challenges.instruction: Look at the yummy breakfast! When do we eat this yummy meal?
challenges.hint: Think about what you do right after you wake up.

challenges.instruction: Time for indoor play! When do we play games during the day?
challenges.hint: Think about the middle part of the day when the sun is high.

challenges.instruction: The rain is still falling outside. When do we clean up our toys?
challenges.hint: Think about what you do before getting ready for bed.

challenges.instruction: Time to brush your teeth and get cozy. When do we get ready for sleep?
challenges.hint: Think about when the moon and stars come out in the sky.

challenges.instruction: The day is done and the stars are out. When do we go to sleep?
challenges.hint: Think about when you close your eyes to dream all night.
